summary: A scheduled occurrence with a time or date, including appointments.

targets.utterance: My dentist appointment is December 8 at 10 AM in London.
targets.distinguish: A completed clinical visit goes to Medical Records. Keep an alarm on the event or its private state.

targets.utterance: Give me a private alert 30 minutes before my dentist appointment.
targets.distinguish: Resolve the existing event record ID and store the alert in the user’s private state. A client schedules delivery.

interchange.scope: Scoped VEVENT conversion. An all-day end date is exclusive.
